name: slap_table
text: A standing person leans forward and lifts the right hand then slaps the palm down once on a table 75cm high in front, emphatically in approval, then lifts the hand back off. Left arm relaxed. Keep the feet planted.

review.reason: 抬右手、向75厘米桌面下拍一次后收回；3帧全身关键姿势，接触目标最大误差2.3厘米，无冻结。
review.known_limitations: SOMA77 单人源动作；未做运行时火柴人映射与场景接触验收。手指无独立抓取动画。
review.post_export_edits: 仅walk_brisk裁剪记录中的完整周期；其余NPZ保持生成输出原样。
review.constraint_source_note: 临时参考路径仅为来源记录；实际约束数值保存在constraint_targets。
